messages:
Sasha M: Hi finance team, quick oneI booked a vendor package for the EU trip but the vendor issued a single invoice covering 5 nights (one of which is personal). Total charged: $1,342.50. How do I get reimbursed only for the business nights?
Expense Bot: Please attach invoice/booking proof. If vendor groups charges, we need manager approval and supporting screenshots. Policy: https://redwood.example/policies/expenses
Sasha M: Invoice PDF: https://travelvendor.example/invoices/INV-98765.pdf  the PDF only shows a total, not nightly breakdown. I have a screenshot from the booking portal showing dates and nightly rate: https://imgur.com/example-screenshot
Lexi (Finance): Hi Sasha  first step is manager sign-off confirming which nights are business vs personal and the amounts. If vendor can't reissue an itemized invoice, manager sign-off + booking screenshot is acceptable.
Sasha M: @Omar R can you confirm the nights? My itinerary: 3/9 personal arrival, 3/10-3/13 business.
Omar R: Confirmed. Business nights 2026-03-10 through 2026-03-13 only. Not approving 2026-03-09. Approved for reimbursement split. :white_check_mark:
Jessie L: One follow-up  meals on the personal night were on Sasha's card. Do we reimburse meals or use per-diem?
Lexi (Finance): For international travel we reimburse actual meal receipts. Per-diem applies only for domestic travel per new policy. Hotel: reimburse business nights only. If vendor cannot provide per-night charges, use portal screenshot + manager signoff to compute split.
Sasha M: Vendor says they cannot reissue an itemized invoice because this was booked via an agency. They provided the portal confirmation (screenshot) with nightly rates but invoice PDF remains one line total.
Lexi (Finance): Ok here's the workflow we'll use: 1) Upload invoice PDF + portal screenshot + manager sign-off to Expensify (or our expense portal). 2) Enter two line items so AP can post corporate vs personal charges separately. Example submission: 
```
Expense type: Hotel
Total charged: $1,342.50
Business portion (4 nights): $1,067.00
Personal portion (1 night): $275.50
Attachments: INV-98765.pdf, portal-screenshot.jpg, manager-signoff.pdf
```
Sasha M: If I already paid the full invoice on my personal card, will I get reimbursed just the business $1,067?
Lexi (Finance): Yes. If corporate card paid some, we'll bill the personal portion back to you. If personal card paid all, we'll reimburse the business portion only. If you prefer payroll deduction for the personal amount, let us know.
Jessie L: VAT reclaim note  the invoice has a "taxes" line but no VAT registration number. Can Finance reclaim VAT?
Sasha M: The portal screenshot doesn't show a VAT ID either.
Lexi (Finance): Without a VAT ID and VAT breakdown we cannot reclaim VAT. Mark the claim as TRAVEL-NONRECLAIM in the coding. If vendor later supplies VAT ID and tax breakdown we can reopen the reclaim.
Sasha M: Uploaded everything to Expensify: https://expensify.com/receipts/abc123 and added manager signoff.
Lexi (Finance): Received. Two final items: (1) Please split as separate line items in the expense submission so our AP can post them correctly; (2) Because the business reimbursement exceeds $1,000 we need CFO sign-off. Looping in @Avery (CFO) to approve $1,067 reimbursement.
Avery (CFO): I reviewed the attachments and manager sign-off. Approving reimbursement of $1,067 for business nights. Proceed with payment.
Lexi (Finance): Thanks @Avery  processing now. Target payment: next payroll (two business days). Sasha, you'll get confirmation email and EXP reference. :email:
Expense Bot: Expense processed (ref EXP-2026-00456).
Sasha M: Appreciate the help. I'll keep vendor follow-up notes in the expense thread in case they reissue an itemized invoice.
